test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some houses are kites.

All mangoes are houses.

All flowers are kites.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some houses are flowers.

(II) No flowers are mangoes.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some houses are kites.

All mangoes are houses.

All flowers are kites.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a63d3d3f60b435e7a1ea6fcfcf3f0cf85b153661baef098781d60745d64a6c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some houses are flowers – Does not follow (Flowers are inside kites, and houses only partially overlap with kites.)

II. No flowers are mangoes – **Does not follow** (Flowers are inside kites and mangoes are inside houses, but there is no fixed restriction between flowers and mangoes.) 

So, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
